server_url.description: The fully qualified server URL to open in jftp on startup, as specified in the SYNOPSIS/OPTIONS.

java_home.description: Path to the Java Virtual Machine binary, as suggested in the EXAMPLE section.

jftp_jar.description: Path to the main jftp.jar executable, as suggested in the EXAMPLE section.

jvm_args.description: List of JVM arguments to pass to the java command. Items are strings.
